resources.string: No app matches “%1$s”. Enter searches the Media Center (a web address opens Web).

Apps in windows on a tablet, an external display and in DeX
App windows: this device supports them.

External display as desktop: off (or not visible to apps).

You turn them on yourself in Developer options – Safeer never changes system settings. Look for the options for freeform windows, making all apps resizable and desktop mode on external displays, then restart the device. The names of these options differ between manufacturers, so we don’t quote them word for word.
Developer options are not on yet: in system settings open the device information (About phone / About tablet) and tap the build number seven times.
This device doesn’t offer this system setting.
Safeer stopped several times in a row as the home screen, so the Home button opens your previous launcher again. You can set it up again whenever you like.
